description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Header' that renders a top navigation bar for a web application. The header includes branding, user balance display, login/logout controls, and links to user profile and inventory modal. It interacts with Redux state slices for authentication and inventory management, and makes an API call for development login.

methods.name: Header()
methods.description: React functional component for rendering the application's header/navigation bar.

methods.name: handleLoginClick
methods.description: Handler function for login button; attempts dev login, with fallback to OAuth redirect.
